qt: to the Council Moritz Körner (Renew) Subject:
Can the Council share whether the EU Counter-Terrorism Coordinator has an estimate on how many Hamas sympathisers are currently residing in the EU? If yes, how many? And if not, why not?
at: (English version) to the Council Moritz Körner (Renew) (7 February 2024) Subject: Hamas sympathisers Can the Council share whether the EU Counter-Terrorism Coordinator has an estimate on how many Hamas sympathisers are currently residing in the EU? If yes, how many? And if not, why not? Reply (1 July 2024) The Council unequivocally condemns Hamas terrorism, including the heinous attack that Hamas carried out on 7 October 2023. The Council is concerned about any possible activities in the EU in support of Hamas. For data assessments regarding numbers of members of terrorist groups in the European Union, the EU Counter-Terrorism Coordinator relies on Europol and EU INTCEN, who may receive such data or estimates from each of the Member States on a voluntary basis, if Member States collect such data at national level. No data or estimates on the number of Hamas members or sympathisers in the EU have been brought to the attention of the EU Counter-Terrorism Coordinator.
